player_prompt.intro:
Ị bụ Player {player_id}. Ị na-egwuri egwuregwu 15-Puzzle.
Ebumnuche nke egwuregwu ahụ bụ ike were usoro nke nkịta ọkọlọtọ site na 1 ruo 15, na oghere efu dị n'okpuru akụkụ nri.
Iji mee mgbanwe, ị nwere ike ịsụgharị nkịta ọkọlọtọ na oghere efu (nke a na-anọchi anya site na ala abụọ, dịka __) site n'iji otu n'ime ọnyịnye ndị a:
- 'up': Buga nkịta ọkọlọtọ dị n'okpuru oghere efu elu.
- 'down': Buga nkịta ọkọlọtọ dị n'elu oghere efu ala.
- 'left': Buga nkịta ọkọlọtọ dị n'akụkụ ekpe nke oghere efu n'akụkụ ekpe.
- 'right': Buga nkịta ọkọlọtọ dị n'akụkụ nri nke oghere efu n'akụkụ nri.
Iji nyefee mgbanwe gị, dee ụdị (dịka, 'elu', 'ala', 'n'akụkụ ekpe', ma ọ bụ 'n'akụkụ nri') na akwụkwọ square, dịka [up].
Ugbu a, layout bọọdụ dị n'okpuru. Jiri nka a mee ihe iji dozie egwuregwu ahụ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ọkpụkpọ na-abaghị uru. Onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} azaghị na ntụziaka ziri ezi na square brackets.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Ntughari na-abaghị uru. A pụghị ịkwagharị tile na ntụziaka akọwapụtara.

outcome.win: Ekele! Onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} emeela nke ọma na-edozi 15-Puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: E ruola oke ntụgharị ahụ. Ihe nlereanya ahụ mezue {percent} pasent nke mgbaghoju anya
